title: Strange Game in Mall World
content: Last night I dreamed about the mall again. This time there seemed to be a tunnel from my house to the mall. The house was very old and the bottom floor had collapsed into the basement. My son, who was about 9 or 10 in my dream, had to go through the basement to the tunnel. Once there, he and a bunch of other kids had to compete in some sort of game tournament that was a combination video and live action game. Contestants had to successfully complete a series of steps, such as building a weapon, before they could advance to the next level. The winner’s family lived, while everyone else was consumed in the tunnel. Everyone knew that what was in the tunnel was something similar to Pennywise. It feeds on humans. Unfortunately or maybe fortunately, I woke up before I found out what happens. It was very unsettling and I hope I don’t go to that part of the mall again.
